declarations.description: Touch-first slider as a light-DOM custom element. Register it with register.js as <swipe-slider>, or call customElements.define with another name. There is no shadow root, so ::part is not used.
declarations.name: SwipeSlider

attributes.name: speed
attributes.description: Transition duration in milliseconds. Forced to 0 when prefers-reduced-motion: reduce matches.

attributes.name: draggable
attributes.description: Allow mouse (and other hover pointers) to drag slides. Touch and pen work without this attribute.

attributes.name: no-mousewheel
attributes.description: Disable wheel navigation. Wheel navigation is on unless this attribute is present.

attributes.name: disable-scroll
attributes.description: Block vertical scrolling that starts on the slider. Also sets touch-action: none.

attributes.name: stop-propagation
attributes.description: Stop propagation of pointer, wheel, and transition events handled by the engine.

attributes.name: passive-events
attributes.description: Register move and wheel listeners as passive and skip preventDefault.

attributes.name: loop
attributes.description: Infinite loop, implemented with clones. Requires at least two real slides.

attributes.name: auto-height
attributes.description: Size the host to the active slide. A numeric value is a minimum height in pixels.

members.name: swipe
members.description: Low-level engine, null until the first animation frame and after kill().

members.name: init
members.description: Rebuild the track from the current children.

members.name: slide
members.description: Move to a logical slide index.

members.name: prev
members.description: Go to the previous logical slide. Does not wrap unless loop is set.

members.name: next
members.description: Go to the next logical slide. Does not wrap unless loop is set.

members.name: getPos
members.description: Logical index of the active slide.

members.name: getNumSlides
members.description: Count of real slides, excluding loop clones.

members.name: kill
members.description: Remove listeners, clones, and the engine instance.

events.name: swipe:change
events.description: Active logical slide changed. detail: { index, element, direction }. direction -1 is next, 1 is previous. bubbles and composed.

events.name: swipe:transition-end
events.description: Transform transition finished. detail: { index, element }.

events.name: swipe:drag-start
events.description: Pointer or wheel gesture started. detail: { index, element }.

events.name: swipe:drag-end
events.description: Pointer or wheel gesture finished. detail: { index, element }.

events.name: swipe:move
events.description: Fired on each drag frame. detail is empty.

cssProperties.name: --swipe-height-duration
cssProperties.description: Duration of the auto-height transition. 0s under prefers-reduced-motion.

modules.description: Side-effect entry that registers the swipe-slider tag and imports swipe-slider.css for bundlers.
